facts.name: Alibaba
sentences: Alibaba's shares moved 5% or more on 14 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 6 November 2026, when the stock rose 1.3%.
The stock is down 35.6% this year, and at $94.38 it sits 46.7% below its 52-week closing high of $177.18 from 22 January 2026.
$1,000 invested in Alibaba five years ago would be worth $566 today.
